data.action: 在暴雨与霓虹反光中单膝点地伫立，嘴里叼着巧克力棒，身后光剑悬浮
data.camera: wide shot, low angle, cinematic noir
data.description: 【德克萨斯 · 龙门天台雨夜信使】暴雨如注的龙门摩天大楼天台上，五彩斑斓的巨型霓虹灯在雨幕中泛起耀眼的晕光。德克萨斯身着企鹅物流风衣，嘴里叼着一根巧克力棒，单手扶在刀柄上迎风伫立，身后的两柄光能剑雨在雨滴击打下发出嗡鸣——「能天使，后方视野确认完毕。目标货车将在三十秒后进入包围圈……准备动手。」
data.lighting: 巨型全息霓虹灯倒影与雨水反光、剑雨金色微光
data.location: 龙门商业区摩天大楼雨夜天台
data.promptProse: High above the rain-drenched cyberpunk metropolis of Lungmen at midnight, Texas stands vigil on a sleek skyscraper rooftop beneath towering holographic neon billboards. She wears her iconic Penguin Logistics hooded windbreaker, calmly biting down on a chocolate pocky stick while rain trickles down her dark hair and wolf ears. Twin glowing golden energy swords hover gracefully behind her, casting crystalline amber halos through the heavy downpour. An atmospheric wide cinematic shot captures the vibrant reflections, moody noir atmosphere, and her unwavering composure in breathtaking anime film quality.
data.title: 德克萨斯 · 龙门天台雨夜信使
